species.real: Anguilla's biggest boat races are held around August Monday, during Carnival, which celebrates the end of slavery in 1834.
species.name: Sloopling

dex.text: Mad for a race, any race, and has been known to enter itself for tide tables. Leans on the wind like a sail.
dex.fact: Boat racing is the national sport of Anguilla, with locally built wooden sloops carrying huge sails and crews who shift their weight on boards.

species.real: A sloop has a single mast, and sailing towards the wind works like an aeroplane wing: the curved sail is pulled forward by lower air pressure on its far side.
species.name: Sloopracer

dex.text: A huge sail on a small hull and nothing sensible in between. Wins by leaning out so far the judges look away.
dex.fact: Anguillian racing sloops are wooden boats with large sails and little ballast, so the crew moves out over the side to keep them upright.
